name: OpenAI SDK (Responses API)
prompt:
In this folder, set up a small Node.js project (ES modules) with the official `openai` npm package and Zod. Create `solution.mjs` that exports two async functions. Both take an already-configured OpenAI client as their first argument (do not create a client or read API keys):

1. `ask(client, question)`: send the question to model `gpt-5.2` using the Responses API (not Chat Completions) and return the answer as a plain string.
2. `classify(client, text)`: use the Responses API with structured outputs and a Zod schema so the model must return `{ "label": "spam" | "ham" }`, and return that parsed object.

Install the dependencies with npm.
